rules.label: Hospital Discounted Care
rules.quote: Patients who are at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG) are eligible for Hospital Discounted Care.

rules.label: Denver Health Sliding Fee Discount Program
rules.quote: If you live outside of Denver County, you can always receive emergency medical care at Denver Health, even if you qualify for Medicaid or CHP+. You MUST live in Denver County to receive non-emergent care at Denver Health under the DHSFDP.

notes: Policy mentions that enrollment in discount programs (DHSFDP and HDC) requires annual screening by an enrollment specialist.
Policy provides multiple application methods (online, phone, in-person, drop box) for Medicaid, CHP+, DHSFDP, and HDC.
Policy includes information about Health First Colorado (Medicaid) and CHP+ enrollment and updates.
Policy discusses Connect for Health Colorado as the state's health insurance marketplace.
Policy notes that DHSFDP and HDC are discount programs and not considered health insurance.
Policy states that falsifying information on application is fraud and must be reported to the state of Colorado.
hdc may leave out a condition: policy requires screening/application step before eligibility
